title: Choosing a Reports filter narrows the report results
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Reports pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Reports area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Reports area and go to the any (for example Sales) report.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the report table.
expected: 1. The report updates to show only the rows matching the chosen filter value, and the chosen value is shown on the filter button.

2. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (exactly which filters apply on each report, the full option lists, and whether results update immediately).
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11903-10573 (Reports filters); design-notes.md §B.6
notes: BEHAVIOUR case — the design does not pin how Reports filters apply. Pending Branko's PRD; VIU-confirm on the build.
